phaseMessage: PAPER PHASE - DO NOT STAKE. 0/120 bets settled before the verdict.
rules: Back the favourite ONLY in races listed here - nothing else.
Not a handicap; 2nd favourite at least 1.5x the favourite's price; trainer not in cold form; still the morning favourite.
The horse is shown 15 minutes before the off - bet then, not earlier.
Bet on the Betfair exchange (Betfair SP or the price just before the off).
Stake is always 1 unit. Never more after a win, never more to chase a loss.
PAPER phase: do not stake until 120 bets have settled and the verdict says LIVE.
LIVE phase stops automatically at -20 units.

stats.backtest: Backtest (Aug-Sep 2026): 180 bets, 55.6% winners, +2.0% at Betfair SP after 5% commission
